final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS value FROM patient_ratios), above_first AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - m.value AS first_difference FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE p.ratio > m.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.ratio), AVG(a.first_difference), AVG(a.ratio - m.value) FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE a.ratio > m.value
